subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Is source-contract inspection plus focused OpenClaw tests enough for this Codex `exec_command` warning fix, or should merge wait for live Codex app-server proof after a branch refresh?
rationale: The source path and Codex contract support the fix direction, but the PR lacks after-fix live app-server evidence and current OpenClaw projection creates producer-route uncertainty.

options.title: Require live proof after refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and provide redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a transcript showing both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly decide the upstream Codex source contract plus focused OpenClaw tests are sufficient despite the missing live turn.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after refresh
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and provide redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a transcript showing both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history touches the warning and mutation helper surfaces most directly among the identified owners.
